title: harmonypy2
description:
Performs Harmony integration as described in https://github.com/immunogenomics/harmony.
Uses harmonypy 2.x (https://github.com/slowkow/harmonypy), a C++ rewrite of harmonypy
that follows the R harmony2 package. Note that the default parameters follow R harmony2
and differ from `integrate/harmonypy` (e.g. lambda is estimated automatically).

Dataset input.title: Dataset input
Dataset input.description: Dataset input using nf-tower "dataset" or "data explorer". Allows for the input of multiple         parameter sets to initialise a Nextflow channel.

param_list.description: Dataset input can either be a list of maps, a csv file, a json file, a yaml file, or simply a yaml                 blob. The names of the input fields (e.g. csv columns, json keys) need to be an exact match with the workflow input parameters.

modality.description: Which modality from the input MuData file to process.

obsm_input.description: Which .obsm slot to use as a starting PCA embedding.

obs_covariates.description:
The .obs field(s) that define the covariate(s) to regress out.
Missing values are not allowed in these columns.

output.help_text: Type: `file`, multiple: `False`, required, default: `"$id.$key.output.h5mu"`, direction: `output`, example: `"output.h5mu"`.

obsm_output.description: In which .obsm slot to store the resulting integrated embedding.

output_compression.description:
Compression format to use for the output AnnData and/or Mudata H5 files.
By default no compression is applied.

alpha.description: Used to estimate lambda when --lambda is not set.

nclust.description: Number of clusters in the model

tau.description:
Protection against overclustering small datasets with large ones.
tau is the expected number of cells per cluster

block_size.description: Proportion of cells to update during clustering.

max_iter_harmony.description: Maximum number of rounds to run Harmony.

max_iter_kmeans.description: Maximum number of rounds to run clustering at each round of Harmony.

epsilon_cluster.description: Convergence tolerance for the clustering round of Harmony.

batch_prop_cutoff.description:
Minimum proportion of a batch's cells assigned to a cluster for that batch to be
corrected in that cluster.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
